% master-plain.tex -- gauntlet-master root C: kernel \cite with the cite
% package, and an inline thebibliography that is partly pasted dcu.bst output.
% Bracketed tags name inventory cases (coverage.md).
\documentclass[a4paper]{article}% [C4] after a comment header, with a trailing comment
\usepackage{cite}% [B3] compresses numeric citation lists
\usepackage{url}
% [B5] dcu.bst output uses \harvarditem; natbib would provide it, so a
% kernel document defines stand-ins before pasting the entries.
\providecommand{\harvarditem}[4][]{\bibitem[#2 #3]{#4}}
\providecommand{\harvardand}{\&}
\providecommand{\harvardyearleft}{(}
\providecommand{\harvardyearright}{)}
\begin{document}
\input{sections/cite-shared}
Alpha and numeric labels: \cite{chu1997,web2024}; pasted harvard entries:
\cite{armagan2013,bai2020}.
% [B4] inline thebibliography: numeric \bibitem{key}, an alpha label, {\em}
% cues, \newblock, \url, a macro defined in the list, a commented-out entry,
% and an explicit \input of a .bbl fragment
\begin{thebibliography}{99}
\providecommand{\noopsort}[1]{}
\bibitem{knuth1984} D.~E. Knuth.
\newblock {\em The \TeX book}.
\newblock Addison-Wesley, 1984.

\bibitem{lamport1994} L.~Lamport.
\newblock {\em \LaTeX: A Document Preparation System}.
\newblock {TeX Users Group} Notes, 1994.

\bibitem[Chu97]{chu1997} F.~Chung.
\newblock {\em Spectral Graph Theory}, volume~92 of {\em CBMS Regional
  Conference Series}.
\newblock AMS, 1997.

\bibitem{web2024} Anthropic. Introducing a protocol. Technical note, 2024.
\url{https://example.org/protocol}
% \bibitem{removed} A commented-out entry.

\input{bib/pasted-dcu.bbl}% [N19] .bbl fragment read inside the list
\end{thebibliography}
\end{document}
